extDescription.message: Print photos from Immich: 3.5×5", 4×6", 5×7" or A4, with layouts, borders and date stamps.

optIntro.message: Adds a print button to your Immich web app.

optInvalid.message: Enter a valid address that starts with http:// or https://.

optDenied.message: Permission was not granted. The server was not added.

optAdded.message: Added $ORIGIN$. Open or refresh the Immich page to see the print button.

optHow1.message: Add the address you use to open Immich in the browser, then allow access.

optHow2.message: In Immich, select photos (or open one). A printer button appears to the left of Share.

optHow3.message: Choose paper, layout and date options, then click Print.
